correctness.rationale: For each order, parity gives exact one-half identity diagonal blocks. The Sturm--Liouville Lagrange identity gives the cross block as nonzero diagonal scalings of a rectangular Cauchy matrix with distinct nodes, hence full rank. Singular-value symmetry then yields the exact half-energy nullity and paired spectrum. The global and contiguous-band counts follow by exact parity counting. Numerical quadrature on 1298 blocks independently corroborates the formulas but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The half-energy value is the natural inside/outside transition for a hemisphere. The theorem computes the exact threshold eigenspace for every finite degree mask without diagonalization, reveals parity as the governing invariant, and gives explicit low-pass and bandpass multiplicities. This is a structural classification rather than a single numerical example or routine normalization check.
